# brig vm-runner

List and destroy the VMs that agents started

## Synopsis

```text
brig vm-runner COMMAND
```

## Description

The vm runner is a service that lets agents in sandboxes start throwaway
VMs on this host, from the images that vm\_runner.images in config.yaml
allows, and drive them through MCP tools: screenshots, clicks and typing,
commands and file copies through the guest agent, snapshots. Create it with
[`brig service create`](brig-service-create.md) NAME --type vm and attach it to sandboxes like any
service.

These commands show and destroy those VMs. SERVICE is the vm runner
service; it may be left out when there is only one.

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`brig vm-runner destroy`](brig-vm-runner-destroy.md) | Destroy VMs that agents started |
| [`brig vm-runner list`](brig-vm-runner-list.md) | List the VMs that agents started |
| [`brig vm-runner screenshot`](brig-vm-runner-screenshot.md) | Save the screen of a VM that an agent started as PNG |
